audit.why: 53.94% over 406 games with an EVEN 5.5/10 label is right for a lane you own before 6 and lose after two items. The mirror kayle__locke reached the same shape and I did not fight it.
audit.corrected: No change to diff or diffRating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4 and 5 carried side 'Locke' while their whys said 'Level 6 is even' and 'First item stays even'; row 6 carried side 'Skill' while its why said late is 'entirely Kayle's' and the packet chart says Kayle.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 — it covers one commit, not the lane, which is why the mid rows belong to Locke. By two items Divine Ascent has given her range, attack speed and wave attacks, which is why the last row is hers.
audit.corrected: whys[4] and whys[5] rewritten to agree with the Locke sides already on the chart (matching the mirror's decision); row 6 flipped as a matched pair to Kayle with rating 4/10 -> 3/10 and phases[6].why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment was described only as 'invulnerability denies your execute'. Its rank-1 cooldown (160s) was never stated, and Starfire Spellblade's missing-health scaling — which punishes the exact HP range Locke likes to fight in — was absent entirely.
audit.why: Riot's text: Starfire Spellblade deals 'bonus damage proportionate to their missing health'. Locke's own passive also scales with the target's missing health, so both champions get stronger as the bars drop and Kayle's version comes on a 6-8s auto-reset while your commit is a 10s blink.
audit.corrected: Missing-health interaction written into dosFull[0].d; the 160s cooldown into whys[4]/whys[5]; Radiant Blast's 12s rank-1 downtime into report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization never mentions Grievous Wounds against Celestial Blessing.
audit.why: Her W is a flat 15s heal at 900 range that also speeds her out of your blink range — it is the reason chip trades do not stick.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now buys anti-heal and names the 15s timer.

edits.before: You out-execute but they out-stat: split where the totem punishes 1v1 greed, and never brawl at full HP — your kit votes at the bottom of the bar.
edits.after: Full Divine Ascent hands her range, attack speed and waves of fire, and her R erases the execute window. Don't duel — fight only where she is forced to peel.

edits.before: Level 6 is even: her R invulnerability cancels your all-in and execute.
edits.after: Level 6 tilts to you: her 160s R covers one commit, not the next.

edits.before: First item stays even as her ranged form starts kiting your burst.
edits.after: First item is yours: her 160s R covers one fight, not the lane.

edits.before: Track Kayle’s Divine Judgment (Invuln): Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Divine Judgment makes her untargetable — it eats your execute outright. Bait it, and punish Radiant Blast's 12s downtime at level 1.

edits.before: Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. Only commit once it is down or baited.
edits.after: W refunds part of its self-damage — hold it for her E smite, which scales off your missing health.

edits.before: Lich Bane first — Spellblade double-dips every mark consume. Shadowflame second (low-HP crunch stacks with your entire identity). Boots by lane: Mercs into AP/CC, Steelcaps into the AD brawlers.
edits.after: Lich Bane first — Spellblade double-dips every mark consume. Shadowflame second (low-HP crunch stacks with your identity). Buy Grievous Wounds before her 15s Celestial Blessing out-heals your chip.

notes: The mirror kayle__locke deliberately kept Locke on rows 4 and 5 and rewrote its whys to match, so I left those sides alone and fixed the whys on this side the same way rather than flipping the chart against it. Row 6 was the one genuine disagreement — side said Skill, its own why said late is entirely Kayle's, and the packet agrees with the why. Locke's ability names remain unverifiable from Data Dragon, so none were changed.
